name: Fuji Komachi
source:
A resident of Room 203, he was a police officer in the real world. He has a caring personality, and, in the morning, you can catch him playing mahjong (badly) or with a hangover.

[Source [URL=https://zombilica.com/games/nienomati_iromusubi/chara_10komati.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
